items.title: Harry Kane wins the Ballon d'Or: "Work hard in silence"
items.summary: At the London Palladium, Ronaldo Nazário handed Harry Kane the Ballon d'Or, the first for an Englishman since Michael Owen in 2001, after a season of 73 goals in 65 games; Kylian Mbappé was second and Lamine Yamal third. "Wow, I'm almost speechless," Kane said, then posted "Work hard in silence. Let success be your noise. 🏆," which got 1.3M likes and was widely read as a jab at Yamal (Kane later said it wasn't aimed at anyone). Guti called it a coincidence that the ceremony moved to London and a Londoner won, Yamal's uncle posted "Very sad," the winners had leaked on the official site hours before the show, and Harry Kane and #BallonDor were the top two US trends.
